# Eric R. Mandell - Professional Profile

## Overview

**Current Title & Organization**

Eric R. Mandell serves as VP, Senior Commercial Lender for Ventura County and North Los Angeles at CDC Small Business Finance[1][2]. He specializes in SBA 504 Commercial Real Estate loans and various financing solutions for small to mid-sized businesses.

**Contact Information**
- Phone: 805-300-0528
- Email: emandell@cdcloans.com
- Service Areas: Los Angeles and Ventura County, California

## Background & Work History

Eric brings over 29 years of commercial lending experience to his current role[2]. His career trajectory demonstrates progression through increasingly senior positions in the banking industry:

**Current Position**
- VP, Senior Commercial Lender at CDC Small Business Finance (April 2019–Present)[2]

**Previous Roles**
- Vice President, Senior Relationship Manager at American Business Bank (February 2016–January 2019)[2]
- Senior Vice President, Commercial Banking at Wells Fargo & Company (September 1991–December 2016)[2]
- Vice President, Area Manager at Wells Fargo & Company (January 1999–January 2003)[2]
- Vice President, Commercial Lending Officer at Wells Fargo & Company (January 1991–January 1999)[2]

**Notable Achievements**

Throughout his career, Eric has facilitated more than $1.5 billion in funding for local business owners[1]. His expertise spans multiple business sectors including manufacturing, wholesale, and professional services, with the ability to assist clients with revenues ranging from $1 million to over $100 million[2]. He is recognized for his mission-driven approach emphasizing responsiveness and transparency in client relationships[2].

## Education

Eric holds a **B.S. in Business Economics and Entrepreneurial Studies** from California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo[2]. This educational foundation supports his analytical and strategic capabilities in commercial finance.

## Specializations & Services

Eric's primary focus areas include:

- **SBA 504 Commercial Real Estate Loans** with only 10% down payment requirements[1]
- Below-market fixed interest rates fully amortized[1]
- New property acquisitions or conventional refinancing of owner-user properties[1]
- No additional collateral pledging requirements[1]
- Building and equipment financing solutions

## Professional Philosophy

Eric is characterized as a partner in his clients' growth journeys rather than simply a lender[2]. He leverages an extensive professional network and market insights to provide tailored financial solutions. Outside of work, he is passionate about empowering small businesses and fostering economic development in his community[2].

## CDC Small Business Finance

**Organization Overview**

CDC Small Business Finance is a nonprofit financial services organization specializing in SBA lending and commercial financing solutions for small businesses. The organization maintains significant assets and operates as a Community Development Corporation.

**Financial Position**
- Total Assets: Approximately $44-50 million range (based on recent nonprofit filings)[3]
- Focus: Supporting small business growth and economic development in California

**Key Services**
- SBA 504 Commercial Real Estate loans
- SBA 7(a) loans
- Building and equipment financing
- Business acquisition and refinancing solutions

**Leadership & Structure**

The organization maintains a professional team of loan officers and senior management, with compensation structures reflecting industry standards for nonprofit financial services[3].
